hypothesis: After controlling past same-venue realized variance, OI contraction adds positive information about next4H squared price variation. Association only, no forced-flow identification or rebound claim.
mechanism: Inventory changes may accompany stress that persists beyond a price shock; aggregate OI nets all opening/closing, so forced liquidation is an alternative explanation not an identified label.
scope: OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP actual public book/OI first-observed only; no legacy Binance or retrospectiveOI. No funding-income, order, leverage, account, paid data.
activation: Not active until predictor code+tests+manifest frozen before outcomes accessed. Window start=max(022 cutoff, predictor manifest freeze time), then60calendar days; never extend based on scores.
feature_quality: Use022 fixed first eligible per15min bucket and17consecutive buckets for pastOI/price. Both source receptions>=start; positiveOI, no fill; max elapsed3h45m..4h15m. Add pastRV from16 log-mid increments with this same past point set, do not edit022.
target_quality: At t use only t features. Label nextRV is sum16 squared log-mid increments across next16UTC15min buckets plus currentpoint. Future price-only books fresh<=30s; do NOT require futureOI availability. Missing price bucket or elapsed outside3h45m..4h15m gives missing target, neverzero; report missingness.
sampling: For statistical sample choose only end UTC15min bucket divisible by4H (6/day); earliest eligible point in bucket, no later replacement. Nearby endpoints may slightly overlap due receive jitter, so episode/day dependence retained.
fit: Expanding OLS refit dailyUTC00, training includes labels actually received strictly before refit and predictions only afterfit; min120 fully observed training samples. Same training rows B0/M1, no parameters/window search. Predict positive RV via exp(log forecast)*mean(exp(training residual)); epsilon1e-12. Nonfinite fit/forecast stops and records model failure.
evaluation: Do not inspect target values or relative scores before predictor freeze; no human evaluation peeks until fixed60day end. Data-quality/coverage and immutable predictions may be monitored without showing labels. Min120 common chronological evaluation targets and>=80percent planned anchors coverage; otherwise inconclusive, no extending window or relabelling known data.
primary: Mean QLIKE(B0)-QLIKE(M1), QLIKE=log(forecastRV)+observedRV/forecastRV. One primary comparison. Day-block moving bootstrap fixed2day blocks10000replications seed20261021; sensitivity1day/4day descriptive only. Need positive point gain AND primary95percent lower bound>0 for incremental forecast evidence, not trading admission.
secondary: Paired logRV squared error, coefficient sign and chronological half gains descriptive only. Record fit/coverage failures. Primary fail cannot be rescued by secondaries. Model can improve volatility forecast without producing net trading alpha.
invalidating: No increment after baseline; negative gain; missingness concentrated in stress; unstable coefficient/halves; inadequate regimes; stale/changed instrument data; numerical failure. Any changes after outcome access create new adaptive trial, no old-plan rewriting.
next_gate: Forecast evidence only -> separate frozen position/risk utility and realistic costs/funding/execution hypothesis; no automatic strategy/portfolio/demo qualification.
publication_limit: Cheng paper examined sections2/3/5; Wan README+full CORRECTIONS examined, PDF raw unsupported and not fully read; independent working paper not authoritative alpha evidence.
